title: Image-coskeleton factorization into an objectwise trivial Kan fibration and a local isomorphism
statement: Let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on a category $C$, let $n\geq1$, and let $f:L\to K$ be a morphism of simplicial presheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Suppose $f_i$ is an isomorphism for $i<n$, $f_n$ becomes an epimorphism after sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and the canonical $n$-coskeleton units of $L$ and $K$ are isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-coskeleton]. Then there exist a simplicial presheaf $M$ and maps $p:L\to M$, $q:M\to K$ with $q\circ p=f$, such that $p(V)$ is a trivial Kan fibration [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration] for every object $V$ of $C$, and $q_i$ becomes an isomorphism after sheafification for every $i\geq0$.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma 01GD (lemma-acyclicity), proof, image-coskeleton construction and objectwise boundary-lifting paragraph; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GD

proof.text: Uncurry $f$ to a set-valued functor on the product of the opposite simplex category with $C^{op}$. Its range subfunctor, curried back, is a simplicial presheaf $S$ with projection $a:L\to S$ and inclusion $b:S\to K$. These are genuine constructions using Subfunctor.range, toRange, and curry. Componentwise $a$ is epic, $b$ is monic, and $b a=f$. For $i<n$, $b_i$ is also epic because $f_i$ is an isomorphism; balancedness of set-valued presheaves makes $b_i$ invertible, and then $a_i$ is invertible too.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma 01GD (lemma-acyclicity), proof, image-coskeleton construction and objectwise boundary-lifting paragraph; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GD

proof.text: Put $U=\mathrm{trunc}_n S$, $T=\mathrm{cosk}_n$, and $M=T(U)$. Define $p=\eta_L;T(\mathrm{trunc}_n a)$ and $q=T(\mathrm{trunc}_n b);\eta_K^{-1}$. Naturality of the adjunction unit and $a;b=f$ give $p;q=f$. Naturality of the counit and the left triangle identity give $\mathrm{trunc}_n(p);\varepsilon_U=\mathrm{trunc}_n(a)$. The counit is an isomorphism since the truncated inclusion is fully faithful.

proof.text: For any finite-limit-preserving functor $\Phi$, apply [lem-weil-pbc-truncated-coskeleton-finite-limits] to obtain a coskeleton preserved by $\Phi$. The uniqueness of right Kan extensions transfers this preservation to Mathlib's ran functor via PreservesRightKanExtension.mk_of_preserves_isRightKanExtension. Thus ranCompIsoOfPreserves gives the natural isomorphism commuting $T$ with $\Phi$, and isCoskeletal_iff_isIso shows that $\Phi$ preserves invertibility of coskeleton units.

proof.text: Apply the preceding preservation to evaluation at $V$. The counit equation identifies $p_i$ with $a_i$ up to an isomorphism for $i\leq n$. Hence $p(V)_i$ is bijective for $i<n$ and surjective for $i=n$. The source is $n$-coskeletal by hypothesis and preservation; the target is $n$-coskeletal because it is a coskeleton, again preserved by evaluation. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coskeletal-map-trivial-kan] to get the objectwise trivial Kan fibration.

source.place: Hypercoverings, Lemma 01GD (lemma-acyclicity), proof, image-coskeleton construction and objectwise boundary-lifting paragraph; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GD

proof.text: For sheafification $A$, $A(b_i)$ is an isomorphism below $n$. At $n$, left exactness preserves its monomorphism, and $A(a_n);A(b_n)=A(f_n)$ makes $A(b_n)$ epic. Balancedness of sheaves of sets makes it an isomorphism. Thus $A(\mathrm{trunc}_n b)$ is invertible. Commuting $A$ with $T$ as above shows that $A(T(\mathrm{trunc}_n b))$ is invertible. Since $\eta_K$ is invertible, $A(q)$ is invertible, so every $A(q_i)$ is invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_imageCoskeleton_factorization
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {L K : SimplicialObject (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u v w))} (f : L ⟶ K)
    (hlow : ∀ i : ℕ, i < n → IsIso (f.app (Opposite.op ⦋i⦌)))
    (hsurj : Epi ((presheafToSheaf J (Type (max u v w))).map
      (f.app (Opposite.op ⦋n⦌))))
    (hL : IsIso ((coskAdj n).unit.app L))
    (hK : IsIso ((coskAdj n).unit.app K)) :
    ∃ (M : SimplicialObject (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u v w)))
      (p : L ⟶ M) (q : M ⟶ K), p ≫ q = f ∧
      (∀ V : C, SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.I.rlp
        (((whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
          ((evaluation (Cᵒᵖ) (Type (max u v w))).obj (Opposite.op V))).map p)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J (Type (max u v w))).map
        (q.app (Opposite.op ⦋i⦌))))
